3 Bedroom + Maid | Full Sea View | Prime Waterfront Location

Apartment for Rent in Creek Edge Tower 1, Dubai Creek Harbour

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this elegant 3-bedroom apartment with maid’s room in the prestigious Creek Edge, Dubai Creek Harbour, offering breathtaking sea and creek views and a refined waterfront lifestyle.

Designed with modern elegance and spacious interiors, this residence perfectly blends comfort, luxury, and tranquility—ideal for families seeking premium living in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Property Features

Spacious 3 bedrooms + maid’s room
Built-in wardrobes in all bedrooms
Floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic sea, creek, and skyline views
Bright open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with high-quality finishes and premium appliances
Large balcony overlooking the waterfront
Master bedroom with en-suite bathroom
Contemporary bathrooms with elegant fittings

Building & Community Amenities

Stunning infinity swimming pool with creek views
Fully equipped gym and wellness facilities
Children’s play area
Landscaped gardens and walking paths
24/7 security and concierge services
Direct access to the Creek promenade, cafés, and retail outlets

Prime Location – Dubai Creek Harbour

Located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, this apartment offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining highly connected:

Approx. 10 minutes to Downtown Dubai
Easy access to Dubai International Airport
Close to major roads, retail, and lifestyle destinations

Enjoy serene living with unmatched views, without compromising on city convenience.
